panels.description: Each week, the share of sittings in which the coach or the person wrote something to the record on each topic. A write's topic comes from what it touches: the kind of event, the fact a question asks for, a pair-bond, a person's parents. A date change alone, a cluster and a write with no topic in the map count as no topic. Test accounts and scratch records are left out.
panels.title: Topics placed in the record, share of sittings by week

with recursive real_dg as (select dg.id as diagram_id, dg.user_id from diagrams dg join users u on u.id = dg.user_id
            where not dg.scratch and u.username not like 'claude-test%'),
sit as (select d.id as sitting_id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id, min(s.created_at) as started, max(s.created_at) as ended,

        join statements s on s.discussion_id = d.id and s.kind::text = 'turn'
        join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id
        where not d.synthetic and d.kind::text = 'chat'
        group by d.id, d.user_id, d.diagram_id having bool_or(sp.type::text = 'Subject')
        window w as (partition by d.user_id order by min(s.created_at))),
msg as (select s.id as statement_id, s.discussion_id as sitting_id, s.turn_id, s.created_at, s.text, s.prompt_version,
               case sp.type::text when 'Subject' then 'person' else 'coach' end as who,

        from statements s join speakers sp on sp.id = s.speaker_id join sit on sit.sitting_id = s.discussion_id
        where s.kind::text = 'turn'),
turn as (select m.turn_id, m.sitting_id, m.statement_id as reply_id, m.created_at as at, m.text,
                coalesce(m.prompt_version, 'none') as prompt_version,
                row_number() over (partition by m.sitting_id order by m.pos) as idx
         from msg m where m.who = 'coach' and m.turn_id is not null),
delta as (select dc.id as change_id, dc.diagram_id, dc.turn_id, dc.statement_id, dc.author::text as author, dc.created_at,
                 x.o, x.d->>'item_kind' as item_kind, x.d->>'item_id' as item_id, x.d->>'field' as field,
                 x.d->'before' as before, x.d->'after' as after,
                 case when x.d->>'field' is null and jsonb_typeof(x.d->'after') = 'object' then 'add'
                      when x.d->>'field' is null then 'remove' else 'set' end as op
          from diagram_changes dc join real_dg r on r.diagram_id = dc.diagram_id
          cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(dc.deltas) with ordinality as x(d, o)),
fieldval as (select dl.diagram_id, dl.item_kind, dl.item_id, dl.change_id, dl.o, kv.key as field, kv.value as val
             from delta dl cross join lateral jsonb_each(case when dl.op = 'add' then dl.after
                                                    else jsonb_build_object(dl.field, dl.after) end) kv
             where dl.op in ('add','set')),
cur as (select distinct on (diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, field) diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, field, val
        from fieldval order by diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, field, change_id desc, o desc),
removed as (select diagram_id, item_kind, item_id from (
              select distinct on (diagram_id, item_kind, item_id) diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, op from delta
              where op in ('add','remove') order by diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, change_id desc, o desc) x
            where op = 'remove'),
person as (select diagram_id, item_id as person_id,
                  max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='name') as name,
                  max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='last_name') as last_name,
                  max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='parents') as parents,
                  max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='gender') as gender
           from cur c where item_kind = 'person'
             and not exists (select 1 from removed x where (x.diagram_id,x.item_kind,x.item_id)=(c.diagram_id,c.item_kind,c.item_id))
           group by 1,2),
bond as (select diagram_id, item_id as bond_id, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='person_a') as person_a,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='person_b') as person_b
         from cur c where item_kind='pair_bond' and not exists (select 1 from removed x where (x.diagram_id,x.item_kind,x.item_id)=(c.diagram_id,c.item_kind,c.item_id)) group by 1,2),
event_state as (select diagram_id, item_id as event_id,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='kind') as kind, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='item') as item,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='symptom') as symptom, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='anxiety') as anxiety,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='functioning') as functioning, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='relationship') as relationship,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='person') as person, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='spouse') as spouse,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='child') as child, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='dateTime') as date_time
                from cur where item_kind='event' group by 1,2),
parent_of as (select p.diagram_id, p.person_id as child, unnest(array[b.person_a, b.person_b]) as parent
              from person p join bond b on b.diagram_id = p.diagram_id and b.bond_id = p.parents),

   select diagram_id, '1', 0, 'own' from real_dg
   union all
   select u.diagram_id, po.parent, u.gen + 1,
          case when u.gen > 0 then u.side when pp.gender = 'female' then 'mother''s line'
               when pp.gender = 'male' then 'father''s line' else 'a parent''s line' end
   from up u join parent_of po on po.diagram_id = u.diagram_id and po.child = u.person_id
   left join person pp on pp.diagram_id = po.diagram_id and pp.person_id = po.parent
   where u.gen < 5 and po.parent is not null),
kin_all as (
   select diagram_id, person_id, gen, side, case gen when 0 then 'self' when 1 then 'parent' when 2 then 'grandparent' else 'great-grandparent or above' end as link from up
   union all select b.diagram_id, case when b.person_a='1' then b.person_b else b.person_a end, 0, 'partner''s', 'partner' from bond b where '1' in (b.person_a, b.person_b)
   union all select p.diagram_id, p.person_id, 0, 'own', 'sibling' from person p join person me on me.diagram_id=p.diagram_id and me.person_id='1' where p.parents = me.parents and p.person_id <> '1'
   union all select p.diagram_id, p.person_id, -1, 'own', 'child' from person p join bond b on b.diagram_id=p.diagram_id and b.bond_id=p.parents where '1' in (b.person_a, b.person_b)),
kin as (select distinct on (diagram_id, person_id) * from kin_all order by diagram_id, person_id, abs(gen), link),
wrote as (select te.turn_id from turn_events te where te.kind='tool_call' and te.payload->>'refusal' is null
            and te.payload->>'name' in ('edit_person','edit_pair_bond','edit_event','edit_cluster','merge_people','remove','undo')
          union select dl.turn_id from delta dl where dl.author='coach' and dl.item_kind in ('person','event','pair_bond','emotion')),
objection(phrase) as (values ('that''s not what i said'),('that''s not right'),('i didn''t say'),('you''ve got that wrong'),
                             ('why are you asking'),('stop asking'),('i already told you'),('check your information')),
said as (select m.*, lower(regexp_replace(translate(m.text, '‘’', ''''''), '(^|[^A-Za-z])''|''([^A-Za-z]|$)', '\1 \2', 'g')) as t
         from msg m where m.who='person' and m.text not like 'That doesn''t fit: [[impression:%'),
word_hit as (select s.statement_id, o.phrase from said s join objection o
             on s.t ~ ('(^|[^a-z0-9''])' || o.phrase || '($|[^a-z0-9''])')
             union
             select s.statement_id, 'no, with a new date or name' from said s
             cross join lateral (select c.text from msg c where c.sitting_id=s.sitting_id and c.who='coach' and c.pos<s.pos order by c.pos desc limit 1) pc(before)
             cross join lateral regexp_split_to_table(s.text, '(?<=[.?!])\s+|\n+') as st(sentence)
             cross join lateral regexp_matches(coalesce(substring(btrim(st.sentence) from '^\S+\s+(.*)$'),''), '((?:1[89]|20)\d\d|[A-Z][a-z]+)', 'g') mk
             where st.sentence ~* '^\W*no\M' and mk[1] <> 'I'
               and lower(coalesce(pc.before,'')) !~ ('(^|[^a-z0-9''])' || lower(mk[1]) || '($|[^a-z0-9''])')),
w as (select dl.*, coalesce(m.sitting_id, (select s.sitting_id from sit s where s.diagram_id = dl.diagram_id
                       and s.started <= dl.created_at order by s.started desc limit 1)) as sitting_id
      from delta dl left join msg m on m.statement_id = dl.statement_id
      where dl.author in ('coach','user') and dl.item_kind not in ('diagram','cluster') and dl.turn_id not like 'undo:%' and dl.turn_id not like 'backfill%' and dl.turn_id not like 'proactive-%'),
qs as (select c.diagram_id, c.item_id,
              max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='kind') as kind, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='fact') as fact,
              max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='item_kind') as target_kind, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='item_id') as target,
              max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='state') as state, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='outcome') as outcome
       from cur c where c.item_kind = 'question'
         and not exists (select 1 from removed x where (x.diagram_id,x.item_kind,x.item_id)=(c.diagram_id,c.item_kind,c.item_id))
       group by 1,2),
topic_map(hook, topic) as (values ('kind:bonded', 'Partners'), ('kind:married', 'Partners'), ('kind:separated', 'Partners'), ('kind:divorced', 'Partners'), ('pair_bond', 'Partners'), ('fact:met', 'Partners'), ('fact:marriages', 'Partners'), ('kind:birth', 'Children and births'), ('kind:adopted', 'Children and births'), ('fact:birth_date', 'Children and births'), ('fact:children', 'Children and births'), ('fact:order', 'Children and births'), ('fact:sex', 'Children and births'), ('person:parents', 'Children and births'), ('person:gender', 'Children and births'), ('kind:death', 'Deaths'), ('fact:alive', 'Deaths'), ('fact:death_date', 'Deaths'), ('fact:cause_of_death', 'Deaths'), ('item:health', 'Health and symptoms'), ('shift:symptom', 'Health and symptoms'), ('fact:health', 'Health and symptoms'), ('item:work', 'Work and livelihood'), ('fact:work', 'Work and livelihood'), ('fact:life_course', 'Work and livelihood'), ('item:schooling', 'School'), ('fact:schooling', 'School'), ('item:places', 'Moves and places'), ('fact:places', 'Moves and places'), ('relationship:fusion', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:conflict', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:distance', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:overfunctioning', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:underfunctioning', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:projection', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:defined-self', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:toward', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:away', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:inside', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:outside', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('relationship:cutoff', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('emotion', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('fact:contact', 'Contact, closeness and distance'), ('shift:anxiety', 'How people were doing'), ('shift:functioning', 'How people were doing'), ('fact:stress', 'Hard times'), ('fact:most_going_on', 'Hard times'), ('person:add', 'Who is who'), ('person:remove', 'Who is who'), ('person:name', 'Who is who'), ('person:parents', 'Who is who'), ('fact:name', 'Who is who'), ('fact:parents', 'Who is who')),
hook as (select w.change_id, w.o, h.hook
         from w left join event_state e on w.item_kind = 'event' and e.diagram_id = w.diagram_id and e.event_id = w.item_id
                and coalesce(w.field, '') not in ('dateTime', 'endDateTime')
         left join qs on w.item_kind = 'question' and qs.diagram_id = w.diagram_id and qs.item_id = w.item_id and qs.kind = 'fact'
         cross join lateral (values ('kind:' || e.kind), ('item:' || e.item),
                                    (case when e.symptom is not null then 'shift:symptom' end),
                                    (case when e.anxiety is not null then 'shift:anxiety' end),
                                    (case when e.functioning is not null then 'shift:functioning' end),
                                    ('relationship:' || e.relationship),
                                    (case when w.item_kind = 'person' then 'person:' || case w.op when 'set' then w.field else w.op end end),
                                    (case when w.item_kind in ('pair_bond','emotion') then w.item_kind end),
                                    ('fact:' || qs.fact)) h(hook)
         where h.hook is not null),
wt as (select distinct w.change_id, w.o, w.sitting_id, coalesce(t.topic, 'no topic') as topic
       from w left join (hook h join topic_map t on t.hook = h.hook) on (h.change_id, h.o) = (w.change_id, w.o)
       where w.sitting_id is not null)
select $__timeGroupAlias(s.started,'1w'), wt.topic as metric,
       round(100.0 * count(distinct wt.sitting_id) / max(n.sittings), 1) as value
from wt join sit s on s.sitting_id = wt.sitting_id
cross join lateral (select count(*) as sittings from sit s2 where $__timeGroup(s2.started,'1w') = $__timeGroup(s.started,'1w')) n
where $__timeFilter(s.started)
group by 1, 2 order by 1

                 x.o, x.d->>'item_kind' as item_kind, x.d->>'item_id' as item_id, x.d->>'field' as field,
                 x.d->'before' as before, x.d->'after' as after,
                 case when x.d->>'field' is null and jsonb_typeof(x.d->'after') = 'object' then 'add'
                      when x.d->>'field' is null then 'remove' else 'set' end as op
          from diagram_changes dc join real_dg r on r.diagram_id = dc.diagram_id
          cross join lateral jsonb_array_elements(dc.deltas) with ordinality as x(d, o)),
fieldval as (select dl.diagram_id, dl.item_kind, dl.item_id, dl.change_id, dl.o, kv.key as field, kv.value as val
             from delta dl cross join lateral jsonb_each(case when dl.op = 'add' then dl.after
                                                    else jsonb_build_object(dl.field, dl.after) end) kv
             where dl.op in ('add','set')),
cur as (select distinct on (diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, field) diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, field, val
        from fieldval order by diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, field, change_id desc, o desc),
removed as (select diagram_id, item_kind, item_id from (
              select distinct on (diagram_id, item_kind, item_id) diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, op from delta
              where op in ('add','remove') order by diagram_id, item_kind, item_id, change_id desc, o desc) x
            where op = 'remove'),
person as (select diagram_id, item_id as person_id,
                  max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='name') as name,
                  max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='last_name') as last_name,
                  max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='parents') as parents,
                  max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='gender') as gender
           from cur c where item_kind = 'person'
             and not exists (select 1 from removed x where (x.diagram_id,x.item_kind,x.item_id)=(c.diagram_id,c.item_kind,c.item_id))
           group by 1,2),
bond as (select diagram_id, item_id as bond_id, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='person_a') as person_a,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='person_b') as person_b
         from cur c where item_kind='pair_bond' and not exists (select 1 from removed x where (x.diagram_id,x.item_kind,x.item_id)=(c.diagram_id,c.item_kind,c.item_id)) group by 1,2),
event_state as (select diagram_id, item_id as event_id,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='kind') as kind, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='item') as item,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='symptom') as symptom, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='anxiety') as anxiety,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='functioning') as functioning, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='relationship') as relationship,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='person') as person, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='spouse') as spouse,
                max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='child') as child, max(val#>>'{}') filter (where field='dateTime') as date_time
                from cur where item_kind='event' group by 1,2),
parent_of as (select p.diagram_id, p.person_id as child, unnest(array[b.person_a, b.person_b]) as parent
              from person p join bond b on b.diagram_id = p.diagram_id and b.bond_id = p.parents),
up (diagram_id, person_id, gen, side) as (
   select diagram_id, '1', 0, 'own' from real_dg
   union all
   select u.diagram_id, po.parent, u.gen + 1,
          case when u.gen > 0 then u.side when pp.gender = 'female' then 'mother''s line'
               when pp.gender = 'male' then 'father''s line' else 'a parent''s line' end
   from up u join parent_of po on po.diagram_id = u.diagram_id and po.child = u.person_id
   left join person pp on pp.diagram_id = po.diagram_id and pp.person_id = po.parent
   where u.gen < 5 and po.parent is not null),
kin_all as (
   select diagram_id, person_id, gen, side, case gen when 0 then 'self' when 1 then 'parent' when 2 then 'grandparent' else 'great-grandparent or above' end as link from up
   union all select b.diagram_id, case when b.person_a='1' then b.person_b else b.person_a end, 0, 'partner''s', 'partner' from bond b where '1' in (b.person_a, b.person_b)
   union all select p.diagram_id, p.person_id, 0, 'own', 'sibling' from person p join person me on me.diagram_id=p.diagram_id and me.person_id='1' where p.parents = me.parents and p.person_id <> '1'
   union all select p.diagram_id, p.person_id, -1, 'own', 'child' from person p join bond b on b.diagram_id=p.diagram_id and b.bond_id=p.parents where '1' in (b.person_a, b.person_b)),
kin as (select distinct on (diagram_id, person_id) * from kin_all order by diagram_id, person_id, abs(gen), link),
wrote as (select te.turn_id from turn_events te where te.kind='tool_call' and te.payload->>'refusal' is null
            and te.payload->>'name' in ('edit_person','edit_pair_bond','edit_event','edit_cluster','merge_people','remove','undo')
          union select dl.turn_id from delta dl where dl.author='coach' and dl.item_kind in ('person','event','pair_bond','emotion')),
objection(phrase) as (values ('that''s not what i said'),('that''s not right'),('i didn''t say'),('you''ve got that wrong'),
                             ('why are you asking'),('stop asking'),('i already told you'),('check your information')),
said as (select m.*, lower(regexp_replace(translate(m.text, '‘’', ''''''), '(^|[^A-Za-z])''|''([^A-Za-z]|$)', '\1 \2', 'g')) as t
         from msg m where m.who='person' and m.text not like 'That doesn''t fit: [[impression:%'),
word_hit as (select s.statement_id, o.phrase from said s join objection o
             on s.t ~ ('(^|[^a-z0-9''])' || o.phrase || '($|[^a-z0-9''])')
             union
             select s.statement_id, 'no, with a new date or name' from said s
             cross join lateral (select c.text from msg c where c.sitting_id=s.sitting_id and c.who='coach' and c.pos<s.pos order by c.pos desc limit 1) pc(before)
             cross join lateral regexp_split_to_table(s.text, '(?<=[.?!])\s+|\n+') as st(sentence)
             cross join lateral regexp_matches(coalesce(substring(btrim(st.sentence) from '^\S+\s+(.*)$'),''), '((?:1[89]|20)\d\d|[A-Z][a-z]+)', 'g') mk
             where st.sentence ~* '^\W*no\M' and mk[1] <> 'I'
               and lower(coalesce(pc.before,'')) !~ ('(^|[^a-z0-9''])' || lower(mk[1]) || '($|[^a-z0-9''])')),
said_last as (select s.user_id, max(m.created_at) as at from msg m join sit s on s.sitting_id = m.sitting_id
              where m.who = 'person' group by 1),
state as (select u.id as user_id, u.username,
                 case when not u.active then 'left' when sl.at >= now() - interval '28 days' then 'active' else 'silent' end as state
          from users u join said_last sl on sl.user_id = u.id),
last_sit as (select distinct on (diagram_id) * from sit order by diagram_id, started desc),
cov as (select distinct on (te.discussion_id) te.discussion_id as sitting_id, te.payload->'coverage'->'after' as c
        from turn_events te join last_sit l on l.sitting_id = te.discussion_id
        where te.kind = 'done' and te.payload->'coverage'->'after' is not null
        order by te.discussion_id, te.created_at desc, te.id desc),
gens as (select diagram_id, max(gen) filter (where side = 'mother''s line') as mother,
                max(gen) filter (where side = 'father''s line') as father
         from kin group by 1),
dated as (select e.diagram_id, count(*) filter (where k.gen <= 0) as own, count(*) filter (where k.gen = 1) as parents,
                 count(*) filter (where k.gen >= 2) as above
          from event_state e
          join kin k on k.diagram_id = e.diagram_id
                    and k.person_id = case when e.kind in ('birth','adopted') then coalesce(e.child, e.person) else e.person end
          where e.date_time is not null
            and not exists (select 1 from removed x where (x.diagram_id,x.item_kind,x.item_id)=(e.diagram_id,'event',e.event_id))
          group by 1),
reach as (select st.username, l.diagram_id, l.started, st.state,
                 (cov.c->>'required')::int as required, (cov.c->>'known')::int as known, (cov.c->>'asked')::int as asked,
                 (cov.c->>'said_unknown')::int as said_unknown, (cov.c->>'declined')::int as declined,
                 (cov.c->>'not_asked')::int as not_asked,
                 round(100.0 * ((cov.c->>'known')::int + (cov.c->>'said_unknown')::int + (cov.c->>'declined')::int)
                       / nullif((cov.c->>'required')::int, 0), 1) as pct,
                 g.mother, g.father, d.own, d.parents, d.above
          from last_sit l join state st on st.user_id = l.user_id
          left join cov on cov.sitting_id = l.sitting_id
          left join gens g on g.diagram_id = l.diagram_id
          left join dated d on d.diagram_id = l.diagram_id
          where $__timeFilter(l.started))
select state, count(*) as records, count(pct) as "with coverage",
       round(percentile_cont(0.5) within group (order by pct)::numeric, 1) as "median coverage %",
       round(avg(pct), 1) as "mean coverage %"
from reach group by 1 order by 1
